unboundTitle: Confirm sign-in to turn on chats

errors.unreachableDesc: The server isn't responding. Check your connection or try again in a moment.
errors.limitedDesc: The server is limiting sign-ins right now. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

keychain.title: Chats need access to your keys
keychain.mac: Chat encryption keys live in the macOS keychain, and access to it was denied. Press Try again and choose Allow.
keychain.linux: Chat encryption keys live in the system password store, and the unlock window was closed. Press Try again and unlock the store.
keychain.windows: Chat encryption keys live in Windows Credential Manager, and access to it was denied. Press Try again.
keychain.again: Access was denied again. Chats turn on once you allow it.
keychain.failed: Could not ask for access. Try again.

unavailable.title: Chat keys are out of reach
unavailable.mac: The macOS keychain is not answering. Chats keep trying on their own, and your history stays on this computer.
unavailable.linux: The system password store is not answering. Start or unlock it. Chats keep trying on their own, and your history stays on this computer.
unavailable.windows: Windows Credential Manager is not answering. Chats keep trying on their own, and your history stays on this computer.
unavailable.again: Still no answer. Chats keep trying on their own.
unavailable.file: The key file in the app folder can't be read. Chats keep trying on their own.

reset.open: Forgot the password? Reset chat keys
reset.title: Reset chat keys on this computer?
reset.lost: Chats saved on this computer are deleted: messages, drafts, unsent messages, photos waiting to upload and the photo cache.
reset.back: Your chats stay on the server. After you confirm sign-in, new messages arrive right away.
reset.history: Older messages come back when you choose It's me on a device you have used for 3 days or more, or on their own after 3 days.
reset.hidden: Messages you deleted only for yourself may show up again.
reset.others: Your other devices will show New sign-in to your chats. Choose It's me. Not me signs this computer out of SoundCloud.

file.mac: New keys go in a private file in the app folder, not in the macOS keychain.
file.linux: New keys go in a private file in the app folder, not in the system password store.
file.windows: New keys go in a private file in the app folder, not in Windows Credential Manager.

reset.probe: If Windows Credential Manager still fails, new keys go in a private file in the app folder.

os.mac: New keys go back in the macOS keychain. If it refuses, they go in a private file in the app folder.
os.linux: New keys go back in the system password store. If it refuses, they go in a private file in the app folder.
os.windows: New keys go back in Windows Credential Manager. If it fails, they go in a private file in the app folder.

reset.failed: Could not clear chat data on this computer. Try again.

limit.title: Too many new sign-ins today
limit.opens: Chats on this computer open by {{time}}
limit.trying: Chats keep trying on their own
